memory_update.text: AXTI remains the cleanest US-listed underfollowed candidate for the InP substrate part of the node, but its AI/CPO link must be upgraded only if filings or calls show datacenter optics-driven demand, pricing, capacity tightness, or named customer qualification.

POET is a US-listed small-cap platform candidate for optical interposer and external light-source integration; main survival test is production conversion and customer validation, not technical narrative alone.

Sivers Semiconductors appears highly relevant to DFB lasers and ELS, but it is primarily Nasdaq Stockholm-listed with US OTC availability; because this pass targets US-listed companies, keep Sivers as a non-US/OTC comparator rather than a primary candidate unless the mandate expands.

Lightwave Logic is a possible US-listed silicon-photonics materials candidate via EO polymers, but it was excluded from the top-three list because commercialization and revenue evidence appear weaker than LITE, AXTI, and POET for this specific pass.

summary: Layer 1B expands the US-listed universe for the AI photonics input node. The cleanest two-lane structure is: Lumentum as the obvious reference leader for CW lasers and InP-based light sources; AXT as the underfollowed InP substrate bottleneck candidate; and POET Technologies as the underfollowed external-light-source and optical-interposer platform candidate. This is a research universe only, not a buy/sell list.
